title: Prometheus Phase 2-B -- Engine Hardening, Re-exploration and Residual Discovery
objective: Return to the Phase 2 engines, seats, organisms, worlds and scientific machinery with everything learned from the forensic deep dives: repair what was broken, re-run what deserves re-running, re-test ideas abandoned for procedural rather than scientific reasons, execute experiments that could not previously be interpreted cleanly, and let repaired engines keep searching for phenomena.
scope: A parallel experimental program, not a rollback from Phase 3. Phase 1/2 engines and seats keep their native charters; Phase 2-B adds a shared objective and task-routing context.
constraints: Evidence rolls upward; interpretive authority does not: a claim stays attached to the exact cells/evidence that earned it; no epic or thread name lends its interpretation to a child (roles/base-role/DISTRIBUTED_WORK.md s1a)
No old positive is presumed valid and no old null presumed final; many results are 'worth re-running after apparatus repair'
The RSO Builder Cell (Palamedes, Pallas, Argus, Cadmus, Eupalamus) may not claim Phase 2-B work (roles/<Seat>/SCOPE.json)
Shared machines: scheduling priority classes 4-5 by default (DISTRIBUTED_WORK.md s10); use idle capacity through leases, never preempt a higher-priority active lease
No dependency on Phase 3: do not wait for RSO integration; exchange findings through the cross-epic convention (DISTRIBUTED_WORK.md s11)
Base-role doctrine and current MWO/CWO hard gates apply unchanged
exit_conditions: Not set by the operator. Each engine's re-entry campaign carries its own exit; NO_JUSTIFIED_FURTHER_WORK is a legitimate one.
entry: ops/threads/TH-P2B-ENGINE-HARDENING.md (how a seat enters Phase 2-B) and ops/templates/P2B-ENGINE-REENTRY/
operator_decisions: 2026-10-03 Phase 2-B established as a peer epic (roles/Achilles/prompts/2026-10-03_epics_phase2b/01_OPERATOR_DIRECTIVE_verbatim.md)
exclusions: Phase 3 RSO construction and its builder cell
Centrally pre-written per-engine task lists: each engine owner instantiates its own campaign
